item.title: NEET UG 2026 Notification Out LIVE: NTA Invites Applications for NEET UG 2026 at neet.nta.nic.in
item.description: NEET 2026 Live Updates: The National Testing Agency (NTA) has started the registration process National Eligibility cum Entrance Test Undergraduate (NEET UG) 2026 today. Eligible candidates can register themselves at neet.nta.ac.in.Last year, NTA started accepting NEET UG applications from February 7 and conducted the exam on the first Sunday of May. The same timeline is being expected this year. Once released, the notification will be available at neet.nta.nic.in or nta.ac.in.
